decisions.reason: The net price display plugin rests directly on the firm's core shop-extension knowledge and is cheap to maintain, though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 signals weaker priority.
Price comparison tracking draws on the firm's analytics and marketplace expertise, so it can serve as the lead tracking plugin into which sibling variants are consolidated.
As a near-duplicate portal-specific variant that has not been visible since 2019, it adds little new learning, and its resources are better pooled into the main tracking solution.
Another overlapping portal plugin with no observed presence since 2019 is a likely candidate for pruning as portal interfaces change and the firm focuses on multichannel tools.
Net price reporting complements the display plugin and uses the same knowledge base, so the firm can keep improving it at low cost despite its reduced visibility.
